"use client"

import { useEffect, useState } from "react"
import { Moon, Sun } from "lucide-react"
import { useTheme } from "next-themes"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export function ThemeToggle() {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false)
  const { resolvedTheme, setTheme } = useTheme()
  useEffect(() => setMounted(true), [])
  const dark = mounted && resolvedTheme === "dark"
  const nextTheme = dark ? "light" : "dark"
  return <Button aria-label={`Switch to ${nextTheme} theme`} title={`Switch to ${nextTheme} theme`} variant="ghost" size="icon" disabled={!mounted} onClick={() => setTheme(nextTheme)}>{dark ? <Sun aria-hidden="true" /> : <Moon aria-hidden="true" />}</Button>
}
